## USMs

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  cat("### Failed USMs\n\n")
  explanation <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one of",
        "these holds, for at least one variable on that USM (among the",
        "variables tested at the species level, i.e. with at least %d",
        "observations over the whole species):\n\n",
        "- its rRMSE ratio vs. the reference version exceeds",
        "**%s%%** (the *critical* threshold), or\n",
        "- **more than %s variables** on that USM individually exceed a",
        "lower **%s%%** *degraded* threshold.\n"
      ),
      min_obs,
      usm_thresholds$ratio_threshold, usm_thresholds$max_degraded_vars,
      usm_thresholds$degraded_threshold
    )
  } else {
    paste(
      "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one",
      "variable on that USM crosses a critical rRMSE ratio threshold, or",
      "if too many variables individually cross a lower degradation",
      "threshold.\n"
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("<p>%s</p>\n\n", tag_list(sp_failed_usms, "Critical")))
  cat(paste0("::: {.callout-note}\n", explanation, ":::\n\n"))
}

# Variables not tested at the species level aren't tested on its USMs
# either (see `USMEvaluation`).
sp_not_tested <- if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  sp_comp$variable[sp_comp$status == "Not tested"]
}
if (length(sp_not_tested) > 0) {
  cat("### Variables not tested\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p>%s</p>\n\n", tag_list(sp_not_tested, "Not tested")
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    sprintf(
      "These variables have fewer than %d observations over the whole ",
      min_obs
    ),
    "species, so they are not tested on the USMs of this species.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Heatmap of the per-USM RMSE ratio used by the USM test (same formula as
# `rmse_ratio` in `USMEvaluation`: (RMSE_eval - RMSE_ref) / RMSE_species,
# restricted to the variables tested at the species level), drawn only for
# the USMs that failed that test so it matches the "Failed USMs" list above.
# Only the `max_usms` most degraded ones are shown to keep the plot readable.
max_usms <- 50
sp_usm <- if (!is.null(rrmse_per_usm)) {
  rrmse_per_usm[rrmse_per_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}
tested_vars <- if (!is.null(sp_comp)) {
  sp_comp$variable[sp_comp$status != "Not tested"]
}
sp_rmse <- if (!is.null(species_stats)) {
  species_stats[
    species_stats$species == sp & species_stats$group == "evaluated",
    c("variable", "RMSE"),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
}
usm_ratio <- NULL
has_usm_data <- length(sp_failed_usms) > 0 && !is.null(sp_usm) &&
  length(tested_vars) > 0 && !is.null(sp_rmse) &&
  all(c("evaluated", "reference") %in% sp_usm$group)
if (has_usm_data) {
  key <- c("situation", "variable")
  usm_ratio <- merge(
    sp_usm[sp_usm$group == "evaluated", c(key, "RMSE")],
    sp_usm[sp_usm$group == "reference", c(key, "RMSE", "n_obs")],
    by = key, suffixes = c("_eval", "_ref")
  )
  usm_ratio <- merge(
    usm_ratio, stats::setNames(sp_rmse, c("variable", "RMSE_species")),
    by = "variable"
  )
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[
    usm_ratio$variable %in% tested_vars &
      usm_ratio$situation %in% sp_failed_usms &
      usm_ratio$RMSE_species != 0, ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  usm_ratio$ratio <- round(
    100 * (usm_ratio$RMSE_eval - usm_ratio$RMSE_ref) / usm_ratio$RMSE_species,
    2
  )
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[is.finite(usm_ratio$ratio), , drop = FALSE]
}
show_heatmap <- !is.null(usm_ratio) && nrow(usm_ratio) > 0

if (show_heatmap) {
  degraded_threshold <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    usm_thresholds$degraded_threshold
  } else {
    20
  }
  ratio_threshold <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    usm_thresholds$ratio_threshold
  } else {
    50
  }

  # Most degraded USMs first: number of variables above the degraded
  # threshold, then highest ratio.
  n_degraded <- tapply(
    usm_ratio$ratio > degraded_threshold, usm_ratio$situation, sum
  )
  max_ratio <- tapply(usm_ratio$ratio, usm_ratio$situation, max)
  usms <- names(n_degraded)[order(-n_degraded, -max_ratio)]
  n_usms <- length(usms)
  usms <- utils::head(usms, max_usms)
  # Variables in the same order as the species-level comparison (most
  # degraded first).
  vars <- intersect(sp_comp$variable[order(-sp_comp$rrmse_ratio)], tested_vars)
  vars <- intersect(vars, usm_ratio$variable)
  usm_ratio <- usm_ratio[usm_ratio$situation %in% usms, , drop = FALSE]

  cells <- cbind(
    match(usm_ratio$situation, usms), match(usm_ratio$variable, vars)
  )
  z <- matrix(NA_real_, length(usms), length(vars))
  z[cells] <- usm_ratio$ratio
  hover <- matrix("No data", length(usms), length(vars))
  hover[cells] <- sprintf(
    "USM: %s<br>Variable: %s<br>Ratio: %+.1f%%<br>RMSE: %.3g (ref %.3g, species %.3g)<br>n_obs: %d", # nolint: line_length_linter
    usm_ratio$situation, usm_ratio$variable, usm_ratio$ratio,
    usm_ratio$RMSE_eval, usm_ratio$RMSE_ref, usm_ratio$RMSE_species,
    usm_ratio$n_obs
  )

  # The color scale is capped at +/- the critical threshold so that a
  # single huge ratio doesn't wash out every other cell (the exact value is
  # in the hover text). It follows the test's thresholds: green = improved,
  # white = unchanged, orange = degraded, red = critical.
  heatmap <- plotly::plot_ly(
    x = vars, y = usms, z = pmax(pmin(z, ratio_threshold), -ratio_threshold),
    type = "heatmap", text = hover, hoverinfo = "text",
    zmin = -ratio_threshold, zmax = ratio_threshold,
    colorscale = list(
      c(0, "#1e8449"), c(0.5, "#ffffff"),
      c(0.5 + degraded_threshold / (2 * ratio_threshold), "#f5b041"),
      c(1, "#c0392b")
    ),
    colorbar = list(title = "RMSE ratio (%)"),
    xgap = 1, ygap = 1,
    height = 150 + 16 * length(usms)
  ) |>
    plotly::layout(
      xaxis = list(side = "top", tickangle = -45),
      yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", type = "category"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#f2f3f4"
    ) |>
    plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE)

  cat("### RMSE ratio of the failed USMs\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Printed from a regular (non-`asis`) chunk so that knitr registers the
# widget's JS dependencies (plotly.js) in the page.
if (show_heatmap) heatmap
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (show_heatmap) {
  writeLines(c(
    "::: {.callout-note}",
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "Ratio used by the USM test: (RMSE - reference RMSE) / RMSE of the",
        "species over all its USMs. Showing %d of the %d failed USM(s),",
        "sorted by the number of variables above the %s%% *degraded*",
        "threshold. Colors are capped at +/-%s%% (the *critical* threshold);",
        "hover a cell for the exact value. Grey cells have no observation for",
        "that variable on that USM."
      ),
      length(usms), n_usms, degraded_threshold, ratio_threshold
    ),
    ":::"
  ))
}
```
